description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryService class, which is part of the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It provides a service layer for managing employee salary data, encapsulating access to the EmployeeSalaryDao data access object. It includes a getter method to initialize and retrieve the DAO object.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryService
classes.description: A service class that manages employee salary operations, utilizing the EmployeeSalaryDao for data access.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalaryDao
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeSalaryDao instance, creating it if it hasn't been initialized yet.
